column4: assert soft-fail: 'Saved' not in hierarchy (vision check decides)

shell: newest=$(adb shell ls -t /sdcard/Pictures/OnionCamera/ 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d '\015'); if [ -n "$newest" ]; then adb pull "/sdcard/Pictures/OnionCamera/$newest" "$RESULTS/taken-photo.jpg" && api_put "eyes $ID: taken photo" "cloud-pc/storage/eyes/results/$ID/taken-photo.jpg"; fi
shell: if [ -n "$newest" ]; then adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "file:///sdcard/Pictures/OnionCamera/$newest" -t "image/jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
